jobs.full: ABOUT ATLYS Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely. Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers. Atlys is changing that. We're building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early. We’re now building AI-native products too, including agents that act on behalf of travellers. THE ROLE We're looking for a Platform & Security Engineer to own the foundations that keep Atlys fast, reliable and secure. Not someone who simply keeps servers running or closes tickets from a scanner. We're looking for someone who treats infrastructure and security as products: who designs systems that are secure by default, automates away toil, and gives every engineer a paved road to ship safely. Few companies handle data as sensitive as ours. You’ll be the second engineer on our Infra & Security team. That means real ownership from week one: you’ll take over large parts of our infrastructure and security roadmap, not a narrow slice of it.
